profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, trading under the ticker DXC, with SEC CIK 0001688568. The website listed for the company is dexus.com. No products are tracked for it, and no lawsuits, MCP servers, or other cases appear in the material provided.

The text on that site does not describe DXC Technology. It describes Dexus, which the site presents as an Australasian infrastructure and real estate fund manager with four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and which the site identifies as Dexus (ASX: DXS). The site says Australia is home to the world's tallest hybrid timber tower, with Atlassian Central reaching a full height of more than 180 metres in Sydney, describes a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds, and refers to a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It also carries disclaimers that the information may change without notice, that no representation is made about its accuracy or completeness, and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The only litigation fact held is exposure recorded in Virginia, with a count of 152. Nothing in the material describes AI products or an AI position for the company.
